rule: For your safety please stay on the trails.
Professional photography is allowed at ONP. Please follow these guidelines and be respectful of other visitors and the environment.
ONP is not available for rent or event usage of any kind. Please see this list of Mansfield Parks that have rentable pavilions.
Golfing and horseback riding are prohibited.
Firearms are prohibited except as authorized by law.
Motorized vehicles are not allowed on the trail or in the park.
Parking is allowed in designated area only.
Inline skates, roller skates and bicycles are permitted on concrete trails only.
Dogs welcomed on leashes per City Ordinance 90.09.
Please clean up after pets per City Ordinance 90.12.
Alcoholic beverages and glass containers are prohibited per City Ordinance 96.05.
Overnight camping is prohibited per City Ordinance 96.20.
Do not attempt to touch, befriend, feed or help any wild animal you encounter while in the park.
The unauthorized removal of plants, animals or other natural resources is prohibited.
Picnics are permitted in designated picnic areas only.
Please deposit litter in appropriate receptacles.
Park hours: Daily 5 a.m. - 9 p.m.  March – October, 5 a.m. - 6 a.m. November – February.
